verify.evidence: PARKED: production now blocks browser writes to public.spatial_ref_sys (OID 19953) with the enabled triggers sec007_rows and sec007_truncate, so the revoke SQL in scripts/ops/secure-postgis-reference-table.sql is no longer needed. The grants themselves cannot be revoked from the postgres role because supabase_admin issued them. Reopen if either trigger is dropped or Supabase support removes the grants.

append.detail: 2026-10-26: addressed in production by the triggers sec007_rows and sec007_truncate on public.spatial_ref_sys, both verified enabled. The browser grants remain (issued by supabase_admin, not revocable from postgres), so effective INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE privileges still show in the catalog but are blocked at the trigger. PR #3918 was closed unmerged. The SQL and a Supabase support request draft are in /mnt/project-files/security/sec-007-postgis-sql-and-steps.md.
